title: HTTP and Resource APIs knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes the purpose of “HTTP and Resource APIs”?
options: HTTP and Resource APIs should be implemented by copying a snippet without checking the Angular version.
HTTP and Resource APIs helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.

questions.answer_key: HTTP and Resource APIs helps explain and implement one part of an Angular application; choose the API pattern that matches the behavior and verify it.
questions.explanation: HTTP and Resource APIs is a concept in the supplied Angular curriculum. Its correct application depends on the intended behavior, surrounding context and verification.

questions.explanation: The PDF explicitly lists “Choosing between HttpClient observables and httpResource” under HTTP and Resource APIs. Anchor it in a small example and check the behavior rather than relying on a memorized phrase.

questions.prompt: What is the strongest verification approach for “HTTP and Resource APIs”?
options: Assume an SVG diagram proves the code compiled and passed tests.
Treat a successful client-side render as backend authorization evidence.
Ignore a failing test if the component looks correct in one browser.
Run the example in a compatible local Angular workspace, test the expected result and one failure case, and document any version limitation.

questions.explanation: Verification evidence should match the running environment. Static teaching snippets are not compiler output, and frontend checks do not replace backend authorization.
